subject: english
topic: Oral English: rhymes (choose the word that rhymes with the given word)

kept.q: Choose the word that rhymes with the word in capitals: BREAK
kept.explanation: BREAK is pronounced /breɪk/. CAKE is pronounced /keɪk/, so both end with the same 'eɪk' sound. BEAK, BLACK and BRICK have different vowel sounds.
kept.pidgin: BREAK dey sound as /breɪk/. CAKE too dey end with /eɪk/ sound, so dem match. BEAK, BLACK and BRICK no get that same sound.

kept.q: Choose the word that rhymes with the word in capitals: KNEE
kept.explanation: KNEE is pronounced /niː/, with a long 'ee' sound. SEA is pronounced /siː/, which has the same ending sound. NEW, NIGH and NET all have different vowel sounds.
kept.pidgin: KNEE dey sound /niː/, with long 'ee'. SEA too get that same /iː/ sound for back. NEW, NIGH and NET no match am.

kept.q: Choose the word that rhymes with the word in capitals: COMB
kept.explanation: COMB is pronounced /koʊm/, with a silent 'b'. HOME is pronounced /hoʊm/, which matches this sound exactly. WOMB has a different vowel sound (/wuːm/), while COMMA and COMMON do not end in the same way.
kept.pidgin: COMB dey sound /koʊm/, the 'b' no dey pronounce. HOME too be /hoʊm/, na the same sound be dat. WOMB get different vowel sound, and COMMA with COMMON no match am at all.

kept.q: Choose the word that rhymes with the word in capitals: SWORD
kept.explanation: SWORD is pronounced /sɔːrd/; the 'w' is silent. BOARD is also pronounced /bɔːrd/, giving the same ending sound. WORD, WORLD and SWARM all have different vowel sounds from SWORD.
kept.pidgin: SWORD dey sound /sɔːrd/, the 'w' no dey pronounce. BOARD too be /bɔːrd/, so dem rhyme well well. WORD, WORLD and SWARM no get that same sound.

kept.q: Choose the word that rhymes with the word in capitals: YACHT
kept.explanation: YACHT is pronounced /jɒt/, not as its spelling suggests. ROT is also pronounced /rɒt/, which matches the ending sound exactly. CHAT, COAT and YACHTING have different vowel sounds.
kept.pidgin: YACHT dey sound /jɒt/, e no follow as e spell. ROT too be /rɒt/, so the sound match well. CHAT, COAT and YACHTING get different vowel sound entirely.

kept.q: Choose the word that rhymes with the word in capitals: CHOIR
kept.explanation: CHOIR is pronounced /ˈkwaɪər/, ending in the same sound as FIRE, which is pronounced /ˈfaɪər/. CHORUS, QUIET and CHOP all have endings that sound nothing like this.
kept.pidgin: CHOIR dey sound /ˈkwaɪər/, e dey end like FIRE wey be /ˈfaɪər/. CHORUS, QUIET and CHOP dia ending no resemble am at all.
